description_en: Creates an asynchronous prediction by calling CreateAsyncPredict
description_zh: 调用CreateAsyncPredict创建一个异步预测
kebab_example: aliyun nlp-automl create-async-predict --model-id 1 --content '全国土地利用总体规划' --model-version V1 --detail-tag false --topk 3 --file-type text,html,pdf,docx,doc --file-url http://127.0.0.1/example.docx --file-content base64_encode_content --fetch-content true --service-name ContractNERPretrain --service-version V1 --api-version 2019-11-11 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAsyncPredict

parameters.help_en: The model ID. Not required when creating an asynchronous prediction by service name and service version. Required otherwise
parameters.help_zh: 模型ID。根据服务名称和服务版本创建异步预测的时候，此参数不必传；否则必传
parameters.name: model_id

parameters.example: 全国土地利用总体规划
parameters.help_en: The prediction content. Maximum length: 1024 bytes
parameters.help_zh: 预测内容，最大长度：1024字节
parameters.name: content

parameters.help_en: The version number of the model. If this parameter is not specified, the latest published version is returned. Specify this parameter when calling the asynchronous prediction operation by model ID
parameters.help_zh: 要获取的物模型版本号。不传入此参数，则返回已发布的最新版本。根据模型ID调用异步预测接口的时候传此参数
parameters.name: model_version

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return detailed extraction results for text entity extraction models. Valid values: true and false
parameters.help_zh: 文本实体抽取类型模型，是否返回详细抽取结果。可选值：true/false
parameters.name: detail_tag

parameters.help_en: The number of top results to return
parameters.name: topk

parameters.help_en: The HTTP URL where the file is stored
parameters.name: file_url

AsyncPredictId.description_en: The unique ID of the asynchronous prediction. You can use this ID to query the asynchronous prediction result
AsyncPredictId.description_zh: 异步预测唯一ID，用于查询异步预测结果
